ingestion_schedule.initial_run: immediately at actual process start time, to the second
ingestion_schedule.missed_boundaries: skip; do not overlap or invent historical realtime samples

bronze.body_format: exact HTTPX decoded response bytes, before JSON parsing
bronze.publication_authority: MySQL collection_runs status and finished_at; filesystem completion alone is insufficient
bronze.retention: retain all local raw; no automatic local deletion

github_actions.storage: one artifact per GitHub workflow run and attempt, uploaded after the collector
github_actions.backup_required: download before artifact expiry; preserve all referenced historical weather captures
github_actions.locator: github_collection.json maps GitHub run/attempt to relative manifest paths
github_actions.failure_boundary: Silver commit and artifact upload are not atomic; upload failure can leave Silver without remotely saved raw

silver.storage: existing MySQL database; no table rename

weather_observations.role: normalized weather with original units and interval

rules: exclude inactive and stale from normal availability metrics
metadata is mutable; historical metadata reconstruction uses Bronze

gold.storage: planned tables in existing MySQL database, separate from Silver tables
gold.input: completed Silver runs and usable observations; no API calls from Gold workers

clustering_runs.cadence: once per New York calendar day

rules: features must be known by input cutoff
store UTC window bounds and use New York timezone for local calendar features
insufficient data produces a status, not fabricated metrics or predictions
